gate3.note: No core filter was added; broad-market sleeve remains default-off paper only.

hypothesis: Broad-market momentum leaders can cluster into the same hidden beta. Replacing high trailing-correlation candidates with the next ranked eligible candidate may improve the default-off paper sleeve by reducing crowded downside without adding new tickers or LLM fields.
interpretation: Trailing correlation is a production-visible crowding proxy aligned with the playbook's broad-market hidden-beta governance direction. Because this still modifies a frozen default-off sleeve selection surface, no shared adapter is changed unless the strict materiality gate is cleared.

llm_metrics.reason: This run avoids sparse LLM soft-ranking and does not alter LLM prompts or decisions.

next_evidence_needed: If forward broad-market paper trades show high-correlation clusters driving losses, retest with live ledger replacement-value evidence before enabling any shared selection rule.

protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: ranking/selection: avoid hidden-beta crowding by replacing candidates whose trailing 20-day positive correlation to open/same-day selected broad-market names is too high.
protocol_answers.2_past_similar_experiments: Broad-market price-floor, rank-notional, low-extension ret5, high-volatility, trend-persistence, score-gap, strong-close crowding, recent-repeat, absolute-score, trend-efficiency, red-day pullback, and max-daily-return variants were tested; trailing-correlation replacement was not formalized for this sleeve.
protocol_answers.3_single_variable: Only max_positive_corr changes; universe, eligibility profile, rank profile, accepted notional scalars, hold, slots, and candidate source stay fixed.
protocol_answers.4_acceptance: Gate 4 requires positive aggregate EV/PnL, all 3 windows EV-positive, no EV/PnL regression windows, >=4 replacements across >=2 windows, concentration guard, <=0.5pp max drawdown worsening, identity control, and >=10% aggregate EV improvement due frozen-sample broad-market crowding retune risk.
protocol_answers.5_reproducibility: Script, JSON artifact, log, ticket, markdown artifact, and JSONL identify windows, parameters, selected/blocked examples, and metrics.

rejection_reason: Correlation-crowding replacement did not clear the strict three-window broad-market materiality gate.
single_causal_variable: positive trailing-20-day correlation cap against open or same-day selected broad-market names
